research_question: Can rank-8 query/document residual adapters trained through fixed-codebook hard-forward IVF residual-PQ recover end-to-end 100K Recall@100 without degrading Recall@10 or the adapted FP32 teacher, before any new RARS sidecar is fitted?
scope: outcome-informed 100K development pilot only; no full-corpus, external, RARS-superiority, SIGIR-readiness, or deployment claim

positioning.eligible_later_contribution: PQ-aware candidate-pool preservation followed by fixed-budget RARS cutoff recovery under a measured storage-latency frontier

data_policy.dataset: MS MARCO passage historical development data, deterministic 100K corpus pilot

training_role.allowed_use: adapter fitting and fixed pair mining

selection_role.allowed_use: epoch selection and the frozen pilot decision

pilot_corpus.selection: all judged-positive documents already observed inside source-role Top-100 candidates, followed by deterministic random fill from the frozen 1M corpus
pilot_corpus.known_positive_denominator: only positive documents observed inside the two source candidate roles
pilot_corpus.selection_candidate_generation: label-independent end-to-end IVF-PQ retrieval; missing positives are never appended to selection results

future_method_holdout.claim_status: identity-only development holdout; not independent confirmation

data_policy.zero_label_semantics: mined unjudged hard negative; never explicit non-relevant

pilot_index.residual_pq_code_assignments: recomputed by hard nearest-codeword assignment for adapted documents; a later deployment would require corpus re-encoding

adapter.initialization: down normal std 0.02; up zeros; exact identity at epoch 0

objective.pair_source: judged-positive versus unjudged hard candidates around the fixed PQ rank-100 boundary
objective.student: adapted query against hard reconstructed adapted document
losses: weighted pairwise softplus on hard-PQ margin
adapted-document to detached hard-PQ reconstruction MSE
objective.selection_evaluation: end-to-end 100K IVF-PQ search at every epoch with nprobe=16 and no positive injection

later_stage_guards.go_authorizes_only: exact replication of this 100K pilot with seeds 43 and 44

required_later_baselines: FP32 exact and exact-within-candidate upper bounds
prohibited_actions: editing this protocol after the first 100K pilot metric is observed
opening or materializing future_method_holdout arrays or labels
calling an unjudged document explicit non-relevant
using official MS MARCO terminology for the known-positive pilot metric
selecting a checkpoint with soft or fake PQ scores
injecting missing relevant documents into selection retrieval results
updating the full encoder, IVF centroids, PQ codebooks, or IVF coarse assignments in Stage A
training RARS, rebuilding the 1M index, or opening an external collection after a single-seed GO
claiming that ranking-aware PQ training or pairwise cutoff loss is new
